titles: C1 snapshotsIdentityEqual: null handling, per-field identity compare, timing ignored
C2 snapshotsTimingEqual: per-field timing compare incl. videos, identity ignored
C3 videoListsEqual: undefined/length handling and per-field compare at each index
C4 buildPowerPointCue: whole-cue mapping, explicit videoRemaining wins over derived
C5 buildPowerPointCue: videoRemaining derived from duration-elapsed only when both present
C6 buildPowerPointCue: darwin forces videoTimingUnavailable=true; win32 passes through
C7 commit first snapshot: LIVE_CUE_CREATED then PRESENTATION_LOADED per room, startedAt = now
C8 re-commit same instanceId: LIVE_CUE_UPDATED + PRESENTATION_UPDATE, startedAt preserved from first commit
C9 different instanceId: ENDED (old cue, all rooms) precedes CREATED+LOADED (new cue), new startedAt
C10 commit null: ENDED then PRESENTATION_CLEAR per room (interleaved); repeat null emits nothing
C11 activeLiveCueId side effect: set to powerpoint:<id> on create, undefined after null commit
C12 debounce boundary: no commit at t0 or t0+599; commit fires exactly at t0+600
C13 timing change mid-debounce keeps the t0 anchor; commit at t0+600 carries the new timing
C14 identity change resets the anchor: commit waits 600ms from the identity switch
C15 announced fast path: same identity + changed timing commits immediately; identical timing emits nothing
C16 null no-op: repeated updatePresentationCandidate(null) with announced null emits nothing
D1 guards: null is inert, foreground without instanceId returns early, none clears via debounce
D2 inSlideshow=false: silent with nothing announced; debounced ENDED+CLEAR when announced
D3 title fallback: whitespace title falls to filename, both blank fall to PowerPoint, title wins
D4 slideNumber undefined falls back to announced slide of the same instance
D5 video source priority: result.videos wins, then editSlideVideos, then cache
D6 warm cache + no-payload polls: silent forever, cache retained (no two-poll clear)
D7 explicitNoVideo: first poll keeps videos (timing dropped), second poll clears them
D8 slide change with explicitNoVideo clears videos immediately after the identity debounce
D9 enrichment: delta>200 marks playing (others forced false), exactly 200 does not, name beats index
D10 timing fallback: undefined duration/playing/remaining keep announced values, elapsed updates
D11 videoTimingUnavailable: true only with a video payload; false (not undefined) without one
D12 explicitNoVideo poll with videoTimingUnavailable:true commits videoTimingUnavailable false
